text:
deploybot: Preflight eval triggered for release/2025-03-12. Prompt-suite: billing_summaries. Quality delta vs baseline: -0.12 (12% relative) on 'summary_quality' metric. Canary is at 10% -> blocking. Options: pin, request-exemption, rollback.

mike.release: Who's owning triage? If it's noisy we can pin to summarizer-v1.9 for the billing route and continue the rest of the rollout.

anjali: I'll do a quick triage. Early signal looks like a tokenization mismatch on a subset of invoices. Could be sampling skew. Need ~30 more samples to confirm.

sara.qa: the failure cluster is mostly long line-items. If triage will take >30m we should consider pin so customer traffic isn't impacted.

ravi.ops: change window closed for the day (outage window passed). Hotfix approval required to push a change outside window. Exemption would need product + eng sign-off.

kai.product: Product is okay with a pin for the billing route only, provided we open a bug and QE signoff post-pin. We do not want a rollback at this point.

mike.release: OK, proposal: pin /summarize/billing -> summarizer-v1.9 for canary and roll forward remaining routes. Collect triage artifacts and re-evaluate next change window. Any objections? Reply with :thumbsup: to approve.

anjali: +1 from ML triage. I'll attach sample diffs to the ticket.

sara.qa: +1 from QA, will run a focused regression sweep on the pinned route.

kai.product: +1 from Product. Please also add a short note in release notes about the per-route pin and follow-up plan.

deploybot: Action items:
- mike.release: run pin command (see example)
- anjali: attach triage samples to TICKET-4392
- sara.qa: regression sweep results posted
- kai.product: update release notes

mike.release: Running pin now (dry-run first):
```bash
redwood rollout set-route --route /summarize/billing --model summarizer-v1.9 --reason "preflight regression" --dry-run
```

mike.release: Dry-run looks good. Applying pin.

deploybot: Pin applied: /summarize/billing -> summarizer-v1.9. Canary remains at 10%. Notifying release channel.

ravi.ops: Noted, monitoring dashboards set for summary_quality and latency. Alert thresholds unchanged.

kai.product: Thanks team. Follow-up: schedule triage sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to decide permanent fix or full rollback. I'll add to calendar and release notes.

anjali: I'll add the sample diffs and a short root-cause hypothesis to TICKET-4392 before EOD.

sara.qa: Will post regression results in the ticket thread once done.

mike.release: Closing thread — pin chosen over rollback per approvals. If any regressions spike, escalate to #release-war-room.
